This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农和他的家人住在古代” / Formula: 在 + time + subject + verb / Correct: “在古代，神农和家人住在一起。” “古代” is a time expression, so use 在古代 rather than 住在古代.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “所以不知道什么植物能吃” / Formula: 在古代，人们 + 不知道 + 什么 + noun + 能 + verb / Correct: “在古代，人们不知道什么植物能吃。” The subject is unclear here. “人们” clearly refers to people in ancient times.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他的家人常常生病了” / Formula: subject + 常常 + verb / Correct: “他的家人常常生病。” “常常” describes a repeated habit or situation, so do not use 了.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他们去很多不一样的地方” / Formula: subject + 去了 + 很多 + different places / Correct: “他们去了很多不同的地方。” Use 了 because this is a completed event in the story. “不同的地方” is also more natural than “不一样的地方” here.

items.reason: “住在古代” can correctly mean living in ancient times, so it does not need to be changed to “住在一起”.
The subject can be omitted here and understood as 神农和他的家人, so it is not unclear or erroneous.
常常 describes a habitual situation, so 生病 should not take completed-event 了.
This completed story event needs 去了; “不同的地方” is also a correct wording.
